name: Create Box Sign Request
description: Creates a signature request. This involves preparing a document for signing and sending the signature request to signers. [See the documentation](https://developer.box.com/reference/post-sign-requests/).

configurable_props.name: signers
configurable_props.label: Signers
configurable_props.description: Array of signers for the signature request. Each signer should be a JSON object with at least an email property. [See the documentation](https://developer.box.com/reference/post-sign-requests/#param-signers) for more information. Example: `{"email": "signer@example.com", "role": "signer"}`

configurable_props.name: parentFolder
configurable_props.label: Parent Folder
configurable_props.description: The destination folder to place final, signed document and signing log. Uses root folder (0) if not specified

configurable_props.name: emailSubject
configurable_props.label: Email Subject
configurable_props.description: Subject of sign request email. If not provided, a default subject will be used

configurable_props.name: emailMessage
configurable_props.label: Email Message
configurable_props.description: Message to include in sign request email. If not provided, a default message will be used

configurable_props.name: redirectUrl
configurable_props.label: Redirect URL
configurable_props.description: The URI that a signer will be redirected to after signing a document

configurable_props.name: declinedRedirectUrl
configurable_props.label: Declined Redirect URL
configurable_props.description: The URI that a signer will be redirected to after declining to sign a document

configurable_props.name: additionalOptions
configurable_props.label: Additional Options
configurable_props.description: Additional parameters to send in the request. See the [documentation](https://developer.box.com/reference/post-sign-requests/) for all available parameters. Values will be parsed as JSON where applicable
